description: This file defines functions and data structures for representing and summarizing the status of nodes, including mapping lifecycle and health statuses to visual representations and aggregating node statuses.

methods.name: lifecycleToKind
methods.description: Converts optional lifecycle and health statuses into a NodeStatusKind.

methods.name: getNodeStatusPresentation
methods.description: Generates a NodeStatusPresentation object based on lifecycle and health statuses.

methods.name: summarizeNodeStatuses
methods.description: Aggregates a list of AgentNodeSummary objects into status buckets.
